accepted_contract: A total rational-output algorithm for every fixed admissible integer pair (N,d) with d not dividing N and every rational compact positive-radius interval, producing a strictly positive gap uniform over all rank-d complex orthoprojectors, all translations, and all radii in that interval.
normalization: Proper complex Gaussian CN(0,I_d), density pi^(-d) exp(-||g||^2); complex modulus infinity norm.
dependency_condition: Accepted centering, ambient equality classification, and positive compact-interval minimum-gap results in the exact dc3fdc source supplied for the task.
passed_checks: Translations eliminated before continuity; no invalid translated-degenerate continuity claim.
Uniform shell estimate including zero-leverage coordinates.
Exact rational projector construction, finite net coverage, and nonempty enumeration.
Correct proper-complex density, pushforward covariance, and real 2d-dimensional integration.
Correct cube tail and global event/density Lipschitz constants.
Exact IN/OUT/UNCERTAIN tests and four-part epsilon error budget.
Terminating outward rational exponential and pi enclosures.
Finite-stage gap soundness and all-admissible-input termination via gamma_k >= Delta - 5 epsilon.
Cell counts separated explicitly from accumulator growth and full bit runtime.
resolved_review_issue: Section 8 was narrowed to individual scalar/form bit costs and explicitly excludes rational accumulator growth and full bit runtime from cell-count bounds.
excluded_claims: An executed numerical positive-gap certificate for a chosen input.
A useful closed-form or input-only analytic gap rate.
Efficient or practical runtime, including a full bit-runtime bound.
A uniform lower gap as dimensions or radius endpoints vary.
General maximizing projectors or reopened N=3,d=2 optimizer work.
Historical novelty, exhaustive attribution, or closure of all ALG-036 gates.
